name: Faceless Explainer Video
summary: Turn a topic, article, notes or brief into an explainer made from original typography, abstract visuals, diagrams and data-viz.
problem: Explaining a topic in video requires a coherent visual narrative even when there is no website, footage or supplied imagery to capture.
coreOutcomes: Turn source text into a concise brief and script
Plan original visual beats using typography and abstract graphics
Build and validate the resulting HyperFrames composition
requirements: A topic, article, notes or creative brief
boundaries: Does not capture websites or use real-world source imagery
Use product-launch, website-tour, PR or caption workflows when those intents apply
